messages:
sam: FYI we saw a short-lived cross-region retry surge between ap-southeast-1 -> us-west-2 around 02:12 UTC. Looks like LB connection churn + TLS handshake uptick caused clients to retry aggressively.

sre-oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0504 (cross-region-retry-surge) assigned to sam for triage.

eva: symptom summary? which load balancers and did cert rotation run recently?

sam: quick notes:
- affected LBs: rwd-edge-ap-12 -> regional egress us-west-2
- errors: increased 523/525 on LB->egress path, slightly elevated TLS alerts from envoy (handshake timeouts)
- timeframe: 02:1202:22 UTC (~10m)
- recent ops: cert rotation job ran 01:58 UTC for ap-southeast-1 (no errors reported)

tony: could be cert timing + connection reuse mismatch across regions. Also noticed a config change to connection idle timeout rolled 01:50.

sam: good catch. I'm capturing logs and will correlate deploys.

rui: I'll add a synthetic probe ap->us-west and increase sampling for TLS metrics. Also will flag retry amplification (client retries >2x baseline) with a pager rule.

eva: mitigation options: 1) transiently increase connection idle timeout to reduce churn 2) rollback idle-timeout change 3) force TLS renegotiation backoff. Which is fastest?

sam: prefer short rollback of idle-timeout change while we audit cert rotation. Tony can you push rollback?

tony: rolling back idle-timeout to previous value now. Deploy plan: staging 02:35, canary 5% 02:40, full 02:45.

sre-oncall-bot: deploy started by tony: rollback-idle-timeout -> staging (build 4902).

ops-docs-bot: linked runbook: docs/oncall/networking/tls-and-retry-mitigation.md

rui: probe added: synthetic-ap-to-usw2-tls, alert threshold set.

sam: after rollback partial rollout we see error rate declining. I'll keep monitoring for 30m.

eva: for postmortem, we need owners + timelines:
- root-cause bisect (sam + tony) 12h
- cert rotation audit (rui) 4h
- add automation: auto-roll back idle-timeout on retry amplification (eva + ops) 3d for PR
- long-term: revisit cross-region connection reuse policy (network infra + runtime) 9d

tony: I'll attach the rollback PR and validation queries in the incident doc.

rui: saved probe graphs and TLS traces to the incident folder.

sam: scheduling a 30m blameless RCA tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Invite list: sam, eva, tony, rui, infra-arch, client-sdk.

eva: also add a recurrence check: correlate past 6 months of idle-timeout changes with cross-region retry spikes. If pattern exists, we escalate to infra design review.

ops-docs-bot: updated incident page with mitigation steps and owners: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2932104567

sam: thanks everyone. Follow-ups tracked on the incident page; will draft postmortem and action items after bisect. :white_check_mark:
